info.name: VoltCart Agent API - Local Classroom Demo
info.description: Run app.py, then execute these requests from top to bottom. Sign in first so Postman stores the local session cookie. The collection demonstrates authenticated agent, cart, order, support and review flows. No OpenAI key is sent from Postman; the Python server reads it from api_credentials.json.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('message_id', 'postman-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(16).slice(2));

request.description: Lists the API endpoints available in this local demo.

exec: pm.test('API index returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Agent chat endpoint is advertised', function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.endpoints.some(function (item) { return item.path === '/api/chat'; })).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Server is healthy', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().ok).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Creates the local HTTP-only session cookie used by protected requests.

exec: pm.test('Demo login succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.email).to.eql('aarav@voltcart.demo'); });

request.description: Shows model/mode metadata but never returns the API key.

exec: pm.test('Configuration is safe', function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('model'); pm.expect(data).not.to.have.property('OPENAI_API_KEY'); });

pm.test('Products match the filter', function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(data.products).to.be.an('array'); data.products.forEach(function (p) { pm.expect(p.price).to.be.below(10001); pm.expect(p.available_stock).to.be.above(0); }); });

item.name: Get Sony headphones by product ID

exec: pm.test('Correct product is returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().product.id).to.eql('AUD-301'); });
var data = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Agent responded with actions', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(data.actions).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('last_agent_mode', data.mode || '');
console.log('Agent mode for this turn:', data.mode, 'Model:', data.model, 'Warning:', data.warning || 'none');

request.description: Stores the returned order ID and message ID for later tracking, cancellation, and an idempotency retry.

exec: var data = pm.response.json();
var order = data.entities && data.entities.order;

pm.test('Order tool succeeded', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(order).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(data.actions.some(function (a) { return a.tool === 'place_order' && a.result && a.result.ok === true; })).to.be.true; });
if (order) { pm.collectionVariables.set('created_order_id', order.id); }
pm.collectionVariables.set('order_message_id', pm.collectionVariables.get('message_id'));
pm.collectionVariables.set('last_agent_mode', data.mode || '');
console.log('Created order:', order ? order.id : 'none', 'Agent mode:', data.mode);

request.description: The same session, message and message_id must return the original order rather than create a duplicate.

exec: var data = pm.response.json(); var order = data.entities && data.entities.order;
pm.test('Retry returned the original order', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(order.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('created_order_id')); });
var data = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Status tool returned the same order', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(data.entities.order.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('created_order_id')); });
var data = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Cancel tool succeeded', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(data.entities.order.status).to.eql('Cancelled'); pm.expect(data.actions.some(function (a) { return a.tool === 'cancel_order' && a.result && a.result.ok === true; })).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Order is cancelled', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.status).to.eql('Cancelled'); });
pm.test('Orders are returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().orders).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Session was cleared', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().ok).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Restores the three seeded classroom orders before the advanced-flow demonstrations.

exec: pm.test('Demo was reset', function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(data.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(data.orders.length).to.eql(3); });

item.name: Build deterministic gaming setup under INR 90,000

request.description: Creates a persisted Pending shopping_plan. It must not create an order.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('approval_token', '');
pm.collectionVariables.set('approved_order_id', '');
var data = pm.response.json();
var plan = data.entities && data.entities.shopping_plan;

pm.test('Mission produced a pending plan, not an order', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(plan).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(plan.status).to.eql('Pending'); pm.expect(plan.items.length).to.be.at.least(2); pm.expect(plan.total).to.be.at.most(90000); pm.expect(data.entities.order).to.eql(undefined); });
pm.test('Plan contains a separate approval command', function () { pm.expect(plan.token).to.match(/^APR-[A-Z0-9]+$/); pm.expect(plan.approval_message).to.eql('Approve ' + plan.token); });
if (plan && plan.token) { pm.collectionVariables.set('approval_token', plan.token); }
console.log('Captured mission approval token:', plan ? plan.token : 'none');

request.description: Reads the exact plan captured from the previous response.

exec: var plan = pm.response.json().shopping_plan;

pm.test('Pending proposal matches captured token', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(plan.token).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('approval_token')); pm.expect(plan.status).to.eql('Pending'); pm.expect(plan.order_id).to.eql(null); });

item.name: Approve mission in a later turn

request.description: Uses a new message_id and the exact token. Prices and stock are revalidated before one bundle order is committed.

exec: var data = pm.response.json();
var order = data.entities && data.entities.order;

pm.test('Approval created one bundle order', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(order).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(order.approval_token).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('approval_token')); pm.expect(order.items.length).to.be.at.least(2); pm.expect(data.actions.some(function (a) { return a.tool === 'approve_purchase' && a.result && a.result.ok === true; })).to.be.true; });
if (order) { pm.collectionVariables.set('approved_order_id', order.id); }
console.log('Approved mission order:', order ? order.id : 'none');
var plan = pm.response.json().shopping_plan;

pm.test('Proposal is approved and linked to the order', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(plan.status).to.eql('Approved'); pm.expect(plan.order_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('approved_order_id')); });

request.description: The ₹84,990 item is above the ₹50,000 threshold, so this prepares a plan instead of placing an order.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('approval_token', '');
pm.collectionVariables.set('high_value_order_id', '');
var data = pm.response.json();
var plan = data.entities && data.entities.shopping_plan;

pm.test('High-value item stopped at approval', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(plan).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(plan.status).to.eql('Pending'); pm.expect(plan.total).to.be.above(50000); pm.expect(data.entities.order).to.eql(undefined); });
if (plan && plan.token) { pm.collectionVariables.set('approval_token', plan.token); }
var data = pm.response.json(); var order = data.entities && data.entities.order;

pm.test('High-value approval placed the exact product', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(order.approval_token).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('approval_token')); pm.expect(order.items[0].product_id).to.eql('LAP-204'); });
if (order) { pm.collectionVariables.set('high_value_order_id', order.id); }

pm.test('Approved MacBook order is readable', function () { var order = pm.response.json().order; pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(order.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('high_value_order_id')); pm.expect(order.approval_token).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('approval_token')); });

item.name: Check return eligibility without changing data

exec: var data = pm.response.json();
var check = data.actions.find(function (a) { return a.tool === 'check_return_eligibility'; });

pm.test('Delivered seed order is eligible', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(check).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(check.result.eligible).to.eql(true); pm.expect(check.result.window_days).to.eql(7); });

pm.test('Informational question created no request', function () { pm.expect(data.entities.return_request).to.eql(undefined); pm.expect(data.actions.some(function (a) { return a.tool === 'create_return_request' && a.result && a.result.ok; })).to.eql(false); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('return_request_id', '');
var data = pm.response.json(); var request = data.entities && data.entities.return_request;

pm.test('Refund return was created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(request.id).to.match(/^RET-/); pm.expect(request.type).to.eql('Return'); pm.expect(request.resolution).to.eql('refund'); pm.expect(request.status).to.eql('Requested'); pm.expect(request.refund_amount).to.be.above(0); });
if (request) { pm.collectionVariables.set('return_request_id', request.id); }
console.log('Captured return request:', request ? request.id : 'none');

item.name: Track refund return in agent chat

exec: var request = pm.response.json().entities.return_request;

pm.test('Agent returned the captured return request', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(request.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('return_request_id')); pm.expect(request.status).to.eql('Requested'); });

pm.test('Direct service request matches captured ID', function () { var request = pm.response.json().service_request; pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(request.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('return_request_id')); pm.expect(request.resolution).to.eql('refund'); });

item.name: List service requests for delivered order

exec: var data = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Order-filtered list includes captured return', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(data.service_requests.some(function (r) { return r.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('return_request_id'); })).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Reset between return and exchange examples

request.description: The seeded delivered order has one unit, so reset clears the return before demonstrating a replacement exchange.

exec: pm.test('Reset restored the three teaching orders', function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(data.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(data.orders.length).to.eql(3); });
pm.test('No service requests remain after reset', function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(data.count).to.eql(0); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('exchange_request_id', '');
var data = pm.response.json(); var request = data.entities && data.entities.return_request;

pm.test('Replacement exchange was created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(request.id).to.match(/^EXC-/); pm.expect(request.type).to.eql('Exchange'); pm.expect(request.resolution).to.eql('replacement'); pm.expect(request.status).to.eql('Requested'); pm.expect(request.replacement_eta).to.be.a('string'); });
if (request) { pm.collectionVariables.set('exchange_request_id', request.id); }
var request = pm.response.json().entities.return_request;

pm.test('Agent returned the captured exchange request', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(request.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('exchange_request_id')); pm.expect(request.resolution).to.eql('replacement'); });

pm.test('Direct exchange request matches captured ID', function () { var request = pm.response.json().service_request; pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(request.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('exchange_request_id')); pm.expect(request.type).to.eql('Exchange'); });

request.description: Leaves the demo in its original three-order state and clears all plans and service requests.

exec: pm.test('Final reset succeeded', function () { var data = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(data.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(data.orders.length).to.eql(3); });

pm.test('Cart is persisted with calculated total', function () { var c=pm.response.json().cart; pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(c.item_count).to.eql(2); pm.expect(c.total).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('Cart belongs to the current session', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().cart.items).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Review summary is grounded', function () { var d=pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(d.entities.review_summary.product.id).to.eql('AUD-301'); });

var d=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Support ticket was created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(d.entities.ticket.id).to.match(/^SUP-/); }); if(d.entities.ticket){pm.collectionVariables.set('support_ticket_id',d.entities.ticket.id);}

pm.test('Human handoff was simulated', function () { var t=pm.response.json().entities.ticket; pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(t.status).to.eql('Escalated'); pm.expect(t.assigned_to).to.include('Human agent'); });

var d=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Comparison is grounded and traced', function(){pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(d.entities.products.length).to.be.above(1); pm.expect(d.trace.correlation_id).to.match(/^COR-/);}); pm.collectionVariables.set('trace_id',d.trace.id);

pm.test('Preferences are stored per user', function(){var p=pm.response.json().preferences; pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(p.budget).to.eql(80000); pm.expect(p.excluded_brands).to.include('Apple');});
pm.test('Seeded delayed order is detected', function(){var d=pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(d.count).to.be.above(0);});

pm.test('Trace links intent, tools, guardrails and usage', function(){var t=pm.response.json().trace; pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(t.intent).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(t.actions).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(t.guardrails).to.be.an('array');});
pm.test('Replay is explicitly read-only', function(){var d=pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(d.replay.read_only).to.eql(true);});
pm.test('Metrics aggregate stored traces', function(){var m=pm.response.json().metrics; pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(m.scenario_count).to.be.above(0);});
pm.test('JSONL export is downloadable', function(){pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Disposition')).to.include('voltcart-agent-traces.jsonl');});
